project_type: Monorepo: React frontend (Vite), Python FastAPI backend, Cloudflare Workers edge proxy
build_system: pnpm workspaces with corepack. Root package.json uses pnpm@10.26.1. Cloudflare Pages uses custom build.mjs orchestrator.
test_framework: vitest 4.x with jsdom (frontend, 65 test files/602 tests), vitest 1.x (edge), pytest (backend)
build_command: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build (requires VITE_BACKEND_URL)
verification_instructions: 1. Run frontend tests from apps/frontend. 2. Run tsc --noEmit for edge worker. 3. Verify gitleaks passes with .gitleaksignore.
setup_instructions: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Node 22, pnpm 10.26.1 available. No Cloudflare secrets can be set from code (wrangler secrets are account-side). Cloudflare Pages and Workers deploy integrations are external - we can only fix code/workflow issues.
contribution_requirements: Monorepo structure: apps/frontend, apps/backend, apps/edge. Workflows in .github/workflows/.
key_patterns: Frontend build.mjs requires VITE_BACKEND_URL (check-build-env.mjs hard-fails without it). Security scan uses gitleaks with --exit-code 1. Quality gate has separate backend-quality and frontend-quality jobs. Performance regression builds frontend then runs Lighthouse.
directory_structure: apps/frontend (React+Vite SPA), apps/backend (Python FastAPI), apps/edge (Cloudflare Workers), .github/workflows (CI/CD)
